mapper.select: SELECT id FROM quant_credential WHERE id=#{credentialId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT max_open_positions FROM quant_risk_config WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId}
SELECT max_open_count FROM quant_strategy WHERE id=#{strategyId}

SELECT i.strategy_id, q.symbol, s.direction FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id JOIN quant_strategy_symbol b ON b.id=i.strategy_symbol_id JOIN quant_symbol q ON q.id=b.symbol_id WHERE i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND s.status NOT IN ('CLOSED','OPEN_PENDING') AND s.position_qty>0

SELECT r.*, e.execution_status, e.exchange_order_status, s.status AS state_status, s.updated_at AS state_updated FROM quant_open_capacity r LEFT JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.credential_id=r.credential_id AND e.idempotency_key=r.idempotency_key LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_position_state s ON s.instance_id=r.instance_id WHERE r.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND r.status='RESERVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_open_capacity SET status='RELEASED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_open_capacity (credential_id, idempotency_key, strategy_id, instance_id, symbol, position_side, reserved_margin, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{credentialId}, #{key}, #{strategyId}, #{instanceId}, #{symbol}, #{direction}, #{margin}, 'RESERVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_position WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND (quantity<>0 OR quantity IS NULL)

SELECT r.idempotency_key FROM quant_open_capacity r JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.credential_id=r.credential_id AND e.idempotency_key=r.idempotency_key JOIN quant_strategy_position_state s ON s.instance_id=r.instance_id WHERE r.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND r.instance_id=#{instanceId} AND r.symbol=#{symbol} AND r.status='RESERVED' AND e.execution_status IN ('CONFIRMED','RECOVERED') AND e.exchange_order_status IN ('FILLED','CANCELED','EXPIRED','REJECTED') AND s.status='CLOSED' AND s.pending_action IS NULL AND s.updated_at>=r.created_at

SELECT r.idempotency_key FROM quant_open_capacity r JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.credential_id=r.credential_id AND e.idempotency_key=r.idempotency_key WHERE r.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND r.status='RESERVED' AND e.execution_status IN ('CONFIRMED','RECOVERED') AND e.exchange_order_status='FILLED'

SELECT r.idempotency_key, r.reserved_margin, e.execution_status FROM quant_open_capacity r LEFT JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.credential_id=r.credential_id AND e.idempotency_key=r.idempotency_key WHERE r.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND r.status='RESERVED'
